attribution.note: Marcus directly states and endorses the criticism.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves his assessment of the paper's title, rather than substituting a claim that no calculations succeed.

contract.note: The contract fairly identifies the unresolved distinction between demonstrating capability and establishing calculator-like reliability.

evidence.note: The contemporaneous paper reports successes and errors. Neither settles what reliability commitment its title makes.

reviews.rationale: Whether the experiments prove the title depends on an unspecified reliability standard. Marcus acknowledges successful calculations, so those successes do not independently refute his contextual objection. No definite criterion settles this assessment of the title.

attribution.note: The assertion is Marcus's own conclusion about the discussed model.

semantics.note: Faithful when the definite reference denotes the evaluated MathGLM system. The broad target label should not expand this into a claim about every possible LLM.

contract.note: MathGLM is the immediate antecedent. Requiring model-specific evidence of its learned computation fairly distinguishes algorithm induction from answer accuracy.

evidence.note: Relevant contextual research on arithmetic generalization, but its different models and addition task cannot establish MathGLM's multiplication mechanism.

reviews.rationale: The packet contains no MathGLM-specific analysis identifying or ruling out a learned multiplication procedure. Errors cannot distinguish an absent algorithm from incomplete learning or imperfect execution; other transformers' addition results do not settle this model's mechanism.

attribution.note: Marcus endorses both the performance description and the interpretation of the model's representations.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the compound assertion and its qualifications without adding an explicit causal link between its components.

contract.note: An overall downward trend is an ordinary reading of steadily declining performance. Separating that trend from strict monotonicity, multiplication-only results, and representational assertions is fair.

evidence.note: Supports the overall mixed-arithmetic decline and widening gap to an ideal exact baseline. The nine-digit rebound defeats strict monotonicity. It does not establish multiplication-only results or a similarity mechanism.

reviews.rationale: The mixed-arithmetic trend and corresponding ideal-calculator gap hold overall, but accuracy rises from eight to nine digits. Multiplication-only decline, similarity dependence, and absence of an abstract representation remain unestablished. Additional training through twelve digits also prevents treating this as a clean unseen-length test.

attribution.note: Marcus directly endorses the empirical assertion about pure LLMs.

semantics.note: The normalization faithfully isolates the empirical learning assertion from the separate recommendation about trust and retains the training qualification.

contract.note: Reliable performance on unseen examples is a fair ordinary test of learning. Addition and subtraction are basic linear functions; requiring perfect performance at arbitrary lengths would impose a stronger criterion.

evidence.note: Contemporaneous Goat experiments report near-perfect direct addition and subtraction on unseen examples after extensive training, satisfying the contract's counterexample criterion.
Documents limited extrapolation beyond the training distribution. This qualifies the demonstrated capability but does not negate reliable learning within the tested domain.
Reports linear-function learning in purpose-trained transformers. The different model setup prevents treating it as a decisive pure-LLM counterexample.

reviews.rationale: Under the contract's fair ordinary reading, Goat supplies a contemporaneous counterexample: a fine-tuned LLaMA reliably answers unseen addition and subtraction problems without external computation. Its declining out-of-distribution accuracy limits extrapolation but does not erase that demonstrated learning.
